verdict.rationale: DeepInfra positions itself as a drop-in OpenAI-compatible API (same SDK, same code), which implies standard OpenAI SDK features like `stream=True` token-by-token SSE would work unchanged, but no evidence pack item explicitly documents or demonstrates streaming responses, SSE format, or token-by-token behavior. Missing for 10: explicit streaming/SSE documentation or examples, benchmarks on streaming latency, and independent confirmation that stream=True works as expected.
